narrative.details: This flame, stolen from the shaman of Thunder Bluff, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
narrative.objectives: Return the Flame of Thunder Bluff to the Festival Loremaster.
narrative.offerRewardText: Unless I miss my guess, this fire has been taken from the cliffs of Thunder Bluff! How it sings with the power of the spirits! You are quite the thief, adventurer. Take this as just payment for your skill. Now, if only we had the flames of all three cities...
narrative.requestItemsText: You're practically glowing, friend. What do you have there?

giverName: an item: Flame of Thunder Bluff
